note: Wired+fixtured mobile screens the rendered-conformance guardrail does not yet ASSERT. A key here is NOT excused from parity — it is a written IOU with the concrete divergence named. Every wired+fixtured key must appear either as a committed tools/parity/expected/<key>.json that PASSES, or here with a real reason; a key in neither fails apps/mobile/src/parity/__tests__/rendered-conformance.test.tsx. Reasons must be >=40 characters and describe the blocker, not 'todo'. Reasons were written from the guardrail's own first run (2026-08-12) against every wired key, so this file doubles as the rendered-drift inventory; as of 2026-08-21 the wired set is 67 keys, of which 24 conform and the 43 listed here do not.
extraction: Listing a key here suspends the ASSERTION, never the EXTRACTION. Every wired+fixtured key must still carry a committed tools/parity/expected/<key>.json — that file is the mock's own truth and is what the blocker named here is measured against. Wiring a target without running `node tools/parity/extract-expected.mjs` is a gap, not a deferral, and the coverage ledger in rendered-conformance.test.tsx now fails on it (11 RC keys wired in PR #795 sat un-extracted for four days because nothing checked).
recheck: node tools/parity/extract-expected.mjs  &&  pnpm --filter ./apps/mobile exec jest rendered-conformance

keys.RC.menu: UIP-06 (fixed): the floating back-chevron collided with the shop-name row — root cause was a genuine cross-platform layout bug, not a render artifact (confirmed via computed DOM rects: the Tappable wrapping the back glyph had no position of its own, so RN's parent-relative absolute-positioning put the wrapper in normal flow after the 92px cover band, offsetting the glyph ~92px down into the name row). Fixed generically in tools/parity/codegen/emit.mjs's wrap() — a wrapper around an already-absolutely-positioned element now gets position:absolute+top:0+left:0 too, invisible to the structural guardrail (Tappable is in its TRANSPARENT set) so the codegen check stays 43/43 and the inner element's own style, which the guardrail DOES compare, is untouched. Regenerated apps/mobile/app/food/menu-cover.view.tsx only. Remaining, not yet asserted: the mock draws a cover banner + logo image slot plus its own menu sample; the app stages Gava's Kitchen with initial-letter fallbacks (fixture photo/menu alignment then a copy pass) — unrelated to the collision, pre-existing.
